text: The Master's Program of International Journalism and Communication cultivates professionals with global vision and strategic mindset. It not only equips students with humanistic knowledge and journalism theories, but also practical skills such as news interviewing, writing, editing, filming and reporting. Graduated students will be fully competent for working in the field of International Journalism and Communication. The Major of Journalism at the School of Television and Journalism of Communication University of China is one of the best in the country. Adding to the excellent faculty team and teaching resources, renowned professionals are invited to give students instructions on their practice. Courses Below is the listing of part of the courses that are planned to be offered: International Journalism Practice Historical Theory of International Journalism International Relations and Public Diplomacy International Journalism Writing and Commentary TV Editing and Directing TV News Program Studies TV Interview Studies TV Image Language Non-linear Editing System
